name: NTIRE 2021 Burst Super-Resolution Challenge
description: This paper reviews the NTIRE2021 challenge on burst super-resolution. Given a RAW noisy burst as input, the task in the challenge was to generate a clean RGB image with 4 times higher resolution. The challenge contained two tracks; Track 1 evaluating on synthetically generated data, and Track 2 using real-world bursts from mobile camera. In the final testing phase, 6 teams submitted results using a diverse set of solutions. The top-performing methods set a new state-of-the-art for the burst super-resolution task.
typical_sota_score: PSNR ≈ 30–36 dB; SSIM ≈ 0.90–0.98 (depending on track and data split)
reputation: A well-known NTIRE challenge benchmark in image restoration that has been widely used to compare burst super-resolution methods.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark with track-specific synthetic and real-world data; results are sensitive to dataset track and evaluation protocol.
